question.question: What happens to immediate-effect versus persistent crafting cards, and can a card in your play area be spent as though in hand?

expected.expected_answer: Resolve immediate effect then discard card. Persistent effect card stays in play area granting its effect. Cards there are not hand cards and can only be spent/discarded/otherwise used if explicitly instructed.

source_passages.section: Actions — Shared movement, crafting and battle (immediate-effect craft)
source_passages.quotation: - Immediate effect (paper box): resolve, then discard the **crafting card**. An item card requires the corresponding **item token** in the map supply, or it cannot be crafted. Take the item token into Crafted Items and score the VP printed on the card, subject to Eyrie exception. The item token stays; the crafting card is discarded. Ordinary factions do not exhaust crafted items as Vagabond does.

source_passages.section: Actions — Shared movement, crafting and battle (component destinations)
source_passages.quotation:
| Separate component after a successful craft | Starts in | Goes to |
|---|---|---|
| Immediate-effect crafting card | Your hand | Shared discard pile after resolving |
| Persistent-effect crafting card | Your hand | Your play area |
| Item token produced by an item card | Map item supply | Crafting faction’s Crafted Items box; when Vagabond itself crafts, it may immediately take its crafted item face up into Satchel/track |

source_passages.section: Actions — Shared movement, crafting and battle (persistent effect)
source_passages.quotation: - Persistent effect (stone box): keep card in your play area and gain its text, subject to the personal duplicate check above. Its card is outside your hand and cannot be spent/discarded/used for another purpose unless explicitly instructed.

answer.ruling: Resolve the immediate effect and then discard the crafting card. If it is an item card, the item token must be in the map supply; take it into Crafted Items and score the printed VP (subject to the Eyrie exception). The card is discarded and the produced item stays. Ordinary factions do not exhaust crafted items as Vagabond does.

answer.ruling: Keep the persistent-effect crafting card in your play area and gain its text. It is outside your hand and cannot be spent, discarded, or used for another purpose unless explicitly instructed.
